# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and minimum residence time (mrt) in the invasion_success dataset
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Check for missing values in mrt and intro.pathway
missing_mrt = invasion_success['mrt'].isnull().sum()
missing_pathway = invasion_success['intro.pathway'].isnull().sum()

missing_mrt, missing_pathway

# Visualize the distribution of mrt by introduction pathway
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt) by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.show()

from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Perform one-way ANOVA to compare the mean mrt across introduction pathways
groups = [invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == pathway]['mrt'] for pathway in invasion_success['intro.pathway'].unique()]
f_statistic, p_value = f_oneway(*groups)

f_statistic, p_value

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare data for regression analysis
X_mrt = invasion_success[['mrt']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor: mrt
y_invaded_plots = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots'].values  # Response: number of invaded plots
y_area_occupancy = invasion_success['area.of.occupancy.10km'].values  # Response: area of occupancy

# Fit linear regression models
model_invaded_plots = LinearRegression()
model_invaded_plots.fit(X_mrt, y_invaded_plots)
coef_invaded_plots = model_invaded_plots.coef_[0]

model_area_occupancy = LinearRegression()
model_area_occupancy.fit(X_mrt, y_area_occupancy)
coef_area_occupancy = model_area_occupancy.coef_[0]

coef_invaded_plots, coef_area_occupancy

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

# Calculate R-squared values for the models
r2_invaded_plots = r2_score(y_invaded_plots, model_invaded_plots.predict(X_mrt))
r2_area_occupancy = r2_score(y_area_occupancy, model_area_occupancy.predict(X_mrt))

r2_invaded_plots, r2_area_occupancy

# Prepare data for multiple regression analysis
X = invasion_success[['mrt', 'intro.pathway']].copy()
X = pd.get_dummies(X, columns=['intro.pathway'], drop_first=True)  # One-hot encode the pathway variable
y_invaded_plots = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots'].values  # Response: number of invaded plots

# Fit multiple regression model
model_invaded_plots_multi = LinearRegression()
model_invaded_plots_multi.fit(X, y_invaded_plots)

# Extract coefficients
coefficients = model_invaded_plots_multi.coef_
intercept = model_invaded_plots_multi.intercept_

coefficients, intercept
